function.name: classify_return_to_or
function.description: Determine whether the current operative episode is an unplanned Return to the Operating Room (RTOR) for the index surgical procedure, applying the Acme Health surgical-quality abstraction rules. Always cite the exact source sentence that justified the determination.

is_return_to_or.description: true if the current surgery is an unplanned return to an operating room that is related to the index surgery and occurs within 30 days; false otherwise (planned/staged, unrelated, outside 30 days, or not performed in an operating room).

evidence.description: The single most decisive sentence quoted verbatim from the operative notes, progress note, or timeline, followed by which abstraction rule it triggers.

function.name: flag_for_human_review
function.description: Escalate an ambiguous surgical case to a human abstractor when the operative notes are contradictory, incomplete, or do not clearly satisfy any single abstraction rule.

reason.description: Why the case cannot be classified automatically (e.g. conflicting documentation of planned vs unplanned, missing operative note, ambiguous location).

candidate_rules.description: The abstraction rules that plausibly apply, e.g. ['Rule 1.1', 'Rule 1.2'].
